001package dev.nandi0813.api.Interface;
002
003import org.bukkit.entity.Player;
004import org.bukkit.plugin.Plugin;
005
006import java.util.UUID;
007
008/**
009 * Connects a bot addon to ZonePractice Pro. One {@link BotProvider} can be registered at a time.
010 * Main thread only.
011 */
012public interface BotRegistry {
013
014    /**
015     * Register the bot provider.
016     * @param owner The plugin that owns the provider
017     * @param provider The provider
018     * @throws IllegalStateException if a provider is already registered
019     * @throws IllegalArgumentException if the provider id is invalid
020     */
021    void register(Plugin owner, BotProvider provider);
022
023    /**
024     * Unregister a provider. Its active bot matches end.
025     * @param provider The provider
026     * @return true if the provider was registered
027     */
028    boolean unregister(BotProvider provider);
029
030    /**
031     * Unregister the provider of a plugin. Called automatically by the core when {@code owner} is disabled.
032     * @param owner The plugin
033     */
034    void unregisterAll(Plugin owner);
035
036    /**
037     * @return The registered provider, or null
038     */
039    BotProvider getProvider();
040
041    /**
042     * @return true if a provider is registered and available, and the core is ready
043     */
044    boolean isAvailable();
045
046    /**
047     * Open the bot practice ladder, arena and round selection. The match starts with {@code options}.
048     * If bot practice is unavailable or the player is busy, the player is told why instead.
049     * @param player The player
050     * @param options The bot options chosen by the player
051     */
052    void openSetup(Player player, BotOptions options);
053
054    /**
055     * Start a bot practice match. If it cannot start, the player is told why.
056     * @param player The player
057     * @param setup The ladder, arena, rounds and bot options
058     * @return null on success, otherwise an error key, for example UNAVAILABLE, INVALID-SETUP, BUSY, CAPACITY,
059     *         NO-ARENA or FAILED
060     */
061    String start(Player player, BotSetup setup);
062
063    /**
064     * The last bot practice setup the player can start again, for example for a rematch.
065     * Expires 1200 ticks after the match ends.
066     * @param player The player
067     * @return The setup, or null
068     */
069    BotSetup getLastSetup(Player player);
070
071    /**
072     * Reserve a new UUID as a bot identity, for a body spawned outside bot matches.
073     * Profiles, statistics and lobby handling ignore it until it is released.
074     * @param owner The plugin that spawns the body
075     * @return The reserved UUID
076     */
077    UUID reserveEntityId(Plugin owner);
078
079    /**
080     * Release a UUID reserved with {@link #reserveEntityId(Plugin)}, after its body was removed.
081     * @param entityId The UUID
082     */
083    void releaseEntityId(UUID entityId);
084
085    /**
086     * @param entityId An entity UUID
087     * @return true if the UUID belongs to a bot body
088     */
089    boolean isBot(UUID entityId);
090
091}
